units.source_text: 這樣的想法愈演愈烈，我只能用搞笑逗家人開心，

en.t: As these thoughts grew more and more intense, all I could do was make my family laugh with jokes,

units.source_text: 甚至在比家人更費解更可怕的男傭和女傭面前，我也拼命地為他們提供搞笑服務。

en.t: and even in front of the male and female servants, who were more incomprehensible and more frightening than my family, I desperately performed my comic services for them.

units.source_text: 夏日，我在浴衣裡面套上一件紅毛衣，在走廊上走動，

en.t: One summer day, I put on what looked like a red sweater under my yukata and walked along the corridor,

units.source_text: 逗得家人笑聲陣陣，甚至連平時不苟言笑的大哥見了，也忍俊不禁，

en.t: making my family burst into laughter; even my eldest brother, who almost never smiled, could not help laughing when he saw me,

units.source_text: 用充滿愛憐的口吻說：「小葉，這樣穿太不合時宜啦。」

en.t: and said in a voice full of fond affection, "Yo-chan, that is really out of season."

units.source_text: 是啊，我當然不是那種不分冷熱，在炎夏穿著毛衣四處走來走去的怪人。

en.t: Of course, I was not the sort of odd person who would ignore heat and cold and wander around in a sweater in the height of summer.

units.source_text: 其實，我是把姐姐的綁腿纏在了雙臂上，讓它從浴衣的袖口露出一截，

en.t: In fact, I had wrapped my sister's gaiters around both arms and let them show a little from the sleeves of my yukata,

units.source_text: 讓他們以為我身上好像穿了一件毛衣。

en.t: so that they would think I seemed to be wearing a sweater.
